name: OpenAI Realtime Agents
description: Next.js demo of voice agents on the OpenAI Realtime API showing chat-supervisor and sequential handoff patterns.
whatItDoes: Users talk to voice agents in the browser and switch between scenarios such as a supervised support agent and a multi-agent customer-service flow. It is for developers designing low-latency voice assistants.
howItWorks: Realtime agents are defined with the OpenAI Agents SDK. In one pattern a realtime chat agent defers hard requests and tool calls to a stronger text supervisor model; in the other, specialised agents hand the user off to each other.
